eligibility: Registration for the Foundation course opens after passing Class 10 (or an equivalent recognised examination). Intermediate through the Foundation route needs a pass in the Foundation examination and in Class 12 (or an equivalent); a Direct Entry route to Intermediate also exists. Foundation registration is valid for 4 years from the first eligible attempt.
entry_route: Three levels: Foundation, Intermediate and Final, including self-paced online modules. Intermediate can be reached through the Foundation route or the Direct Entry route. Students register through ICAI's Self Service Portal.
training: Practical training (articleship) is part of the scheme. ICAI's September 2025 Final examination notice asks for a completed prescribed period of 3 years of articleship training: https://resource.cdn.icai.org/85259exam-final-sep2025.pdf
source_title: Frequently Asked Questions on the CA course, new Scheme of Education and Training
source_publisher: The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India

eligibility: CSEET (the entrance test) is open to students who have passed or are appearing in the Senior Secondary examination (or equivalent). The Executive Programme is open to, among others, graduates and postgraduates, CS Foundation pass students, ICMAI Final pass students and ICAI Intermediate pass students; students in the final year or semester of a three-year undergraduate programme can register provisionally.
entry_route: Stages listed by ICSI: CSEET, Executive Programme, Professional Programme, pre-membership training, then CS membership.
training: ICSI's 2024 student training guidelines describe a one-day orientation programme, an executive development programme and long-term practical training: https://www.icsi.edu/media/filer_public/79/f4/79f4ef2a-c0da-4489-8357-c919944ac343/icsistudenttainingguidelines_1st_jan_2024.pdf
source_publisher: The Institute of Company Secretaries of India

eligibility: Foundation course: Class 10 or equivalent from a recognised board; the ICMAI page also lists a Senior Secondary (10+2) or equivalent pass among the Foundation conditions. Intermediate course: a 10+2 pass plus the ICMAI Foundation course, or a graduation in any discipline. A pass in ICAI Intermediate exempts from the Foundation course, as does a pass in the ICSI Foundation examination.
entry_route: Foundation, Intermediate and Final levels. Admission details: https://icmai.in/ClntStudents/Student_Admission
training: For students registered for Intermediate on or after 11 February 2020, practical training is 15 months (https://icmai.in/Home/NewPracticalTrainingScheme2020). Intermediate students also have a 120-hour skills training requirement (https://icmai.in/ClntStudents/SkillsTraining_Intermediate).
recognition: The Institute of Cost Accountants of India is a statutory body set up under an Act of Parliament in 1959 that regulates the profession of cost and management accountancy in India.
source_publisher: The Institute of Cost Accountants of India

eligibility: To enrol and register for Level I you need a bachelor's degree or equivalent, or be an undergraduate within the window CFA Institute sets before graduation, or have a combination of work experience and education as its policies describe; a passport is also needed. For Level II you must be within 11 months of graduation, and for Level III you must have completed your bachelor's degree or accrued 4,000 hours of professional work experience.
entry_route: Three exams (Level I, II and III) plus Practical Skills Modules; at least one module is completed at each level before results are released. Details: https://www.cfainstitute.org/programs/cfa-program/exam
training: To earn the charter you also need 4,000 hours of relevant work experience over at least 36 months, and charterholder membership with professional references. Work experience can be gained before, during or after the exams: https://www.cfainstitute.org/membership/types/charterholder
cost_note: CFA Institute's own comparison page lists exam fees of $2,550 to $4,800 (US dollars) and a programme duration of 3 to 4 years: https://www.cfainstitute.org/programs/cfa-program
